sentences.text: Nimish Harshad Shah & Ors vs Unknown on 8 November, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
 13
08-11-2024
Ct. No.34 b.das Crr No. 4059 of 2024 In the matter of : Nimish Harshad Shah & Ors.
..... petitioners.
Mr. Satadru Lahiri Mr. Jyotirmoy Talukder ...for the petitioners.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that there was a domestic dispute between the parties for which several litigations were pending between them.
Subsequently, the parties chose to settle all the disputes amicably and both the parties have withdrawn their respective cases filed before different Courts.
Only the present complaint under Section 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code registered as CGR Case No.2154 of 2018 is pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 6 th Court, Alipore.

Learned counsel takes this Court to an order passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, 7 th Court,
Alipore on 15th November, 2021 in C. Case No.4153 of 2016 which records that the case was withdrawn by the private opposite party who was restrained from filing fresh case on the same cause of action without the leave of the Court.
Learned counsel further submits that next date of hearing before the learned Trial Court is 14 th November, 2024.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the same heading on 26th November, 2024.

Further proceedings of CGR Case No.2154 of 2018 is pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate,
6 th Court, Alipore be stayed till 30th November, 2024 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
Urgent certified website copy of the order, if applied for, be given to the parties on compliance of requisite formalities.

( Suvra Ghosh, J. )
